descriptions.preferred: 由荷兰的索恩库特苗圃选育，夏金上的枝变品种， 完美的继承了夏金的色彩特性，安妮艾琳具有典型 的爪型叶，一般为 5 叶裂，叶缘有较大的锯齿并呈 褶皱状，春天新叶为明亮的金黄色，叶边呈鲜红色， 春天成熟叶随着时间推移越来越黄，红色叶边渐渐 褪去，夏天为黄绿色，秋天变为明亮的火红色，色 彩变化鲜明，观赏性极强，生长速度较慢，矮性品种， 夏季午后需要遮阴，成年株可达 2. 5 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A small, upright, slow-growing tree ultimately to about 3m in height and spread. The leaves have five, toothed, tapering lobes opening lime green, becoming yellow-green in summer with red-flushed edges and yellow-orange in autumn. Inconspicuous red flowers in spring are followed by red and green, winged fruit in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 小型、直立、缓慢生长的树，最终高和冠幅约 3 米。 叶具 5 个具齿尖裂片，初展时为青柠绿色，夏季转为黄绿色，叶缘带红晕，秋季呈黄橙色。 春季开不显眼的红色花，秋季结红绿色翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病
